FlowerPainter.Workflow.Choose: What would you like to plant?
FlowerPainter.Workflow.StartTip: Images and flags: design, place, then plant. Other flowers: draw an area first. Click existing flowers on the map to edit them.
FlowerPainter.Workflow.ClickGround: Click the ground to place; right-click or Esc cancels.
FlowerPainter.Workflow.FinishGesture: Finish or cancel the current drag first.
FlowerPainter.Workflow.DoneTip: Your flowers are built. Place another copy, or finish. Click a built group to edit it.
FlowerPainter.Workflow.Unapplied: Not applied — your choices are kept when switching regions.
FlowerPainter.Floral.Issue.PlaceImage: Place the image on the ground first.
FlowerPainter.UI.Patches.SpacingTip: Smaller blossom spacing makes finer, smaller flowers. Higher flower density adds more flowers at the same size and costs more performance.
